wikidot5e:feat:quicksmithing.effectSummary: Master two magical effects, each reproducing a 1st-level ritual-tag spell from any class list, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability. You can learn additional ritual-tag spells from quicksmithing schematics or another quicksmith if their level is no higher than half your level rounded up, spending 2 hours and 50 gp per spell level. Gain proficiency with quicksmith's tools. With 1 hour and 10 gp of materials, create a Tiny clockwork device with AC 5 and 1 HP that functions for 24 hours unless maintained; you may have up to three active and dismantle one as an action to recover its materials. Choose each device as a random-moving noisy clockwork toy, an action-operated fire starter, or a music box that plays one song.

wikidot5e:feat:remarkable-recovery.effectSummary: Increase Constitution by 1, maximum 20. When successfully stabilized while dying, regain HP equal to your Constitution modifier, minimum 1. Whenever you regain HP from a spell, potion, or class feature other than this feat, regain additional HP equal to your Constitution modifier, minimum 1.

wikidot5e:feat:resilient.effectSummary: Choose one ability score. Increase it by 1, maximum 20, and gain proficiency in saving throws using that ability.

wikidot5e:feat:revenant-blade.effectSummary: Increase Dexterity or Strength by 1, maximum 20. While holding a double-bladed scimitar in two hands, gain +1 AC. A double-bladed scimitar gains the finesse property for you.

wikidot5e:feat:righteous-heritor.effectSummary: Increase one ability score by 1, maximum 20. When you or a creature within 30 feet takes damage, use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + proficiency bonus. Uses equal proficiency bonus per long rest.

wikidot5e:feat:righteous-heritor-ua.effectSummary: Increase one ability score by 1, maximum 20. When you or a visible creature within 30 feet takes damage, use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + proficiency bonus. Uses equal proficiency bonus per long rest.

wikidot5e:feat:ritual-caster.effectSummary: Choose bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard and gain a ritual book containing two 1st-level ritual-tag spells from that class list. The chosen class sets the spellcasting ability: Charisma for bard, sorcerer, or warlock; Wisdom for cleric or druid; Intelligence for wizard. You may copy additional written ritual spells from that list if the spell level is no higher than half your level rounded up, spending 2 hours and 50 gp per spell level.

wikidot5e:feat:rune-carver-adept-revised.effectSummary: Increase by 1, maximum 20, the spellcasting ability chosen for Rune Carver Apprentice. When you cast a Rune Spells-table spell or a spell whose school matches the spell marked on your Rune Carver Apprentice object, you may invoke one runic benefit: give a visible creature within 30 feet advantage on its next attack before the end of its next turn; give a visible creature temporary HP equal to your level; or give a visible creature +10 feet walking speed and no opportunity attacks from its movement until the end of its turn. Uses equal proficiency bonus per long rest, no more than once per spell cast.

wikidot5e:feat:rune-carver-adept-ua.effectSummary: After each long rest, you may mark a number of objects equal to proficiency bonus with different runes from Rune Carver Apprentice. An object can bear only one rune at a time, and each marked object must use a different rune.

wikidot5e:feat:rune-carver-apprentice-re.effectSummary: Learn comprehend languages and cast it once without a slot per long rest and also with slots. Learn two runes, replaceable one at a time whenever you gain a level. After each long rest, mark one nonmagical object with a known rune and temporarily learn its 1st-level spell until the next long rest: Death—ray of sickness; Dragon—chromatic orb; Enemy—disguise self; Friend—speak with animals; Journey—longstrider; King—command; Mountain—entangle; Sacred—sanctuary. While wearing or carrying the marked object, cast that rune spell once without a slot or material components and also with appropriate slots. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the feat's spellcasting ability.
